# Verify What’s Real, Protect What Matters, and Transact with Confidence

Digimarc solutions are the trust layer for the modern world. They enable people, businesses, and
systems to identify, authenticate, and protect both physical products and digital content so that
the world can transact and interact with confidence.

## Delivering scalable, verified trust for transactions, products, and digital information

In our increasingly AI-driven world, it’s hard to know what’s real, and trust and truth are
increasingly under attack. Digimarc delivers a breakthrough approach to scalable trust with
solutions that enable people and intelligent systems to instantly verify what’s real, protect what
matters, and act with confidence.  

Verifiable authenticity. Automated tamper detection. Covert leak detection. Robust shrink
prevention. Traceable usage and accountability. Digital identification of provenance, authorship,
and ownership. And scalable trust spanning both the physical and digital worlds. These are just some
of the ways our solutions solve diverse business problems using cutting-edge technologies like
digital watermarking, fingerprinting, cryptography, and AI.

## Welcome to NAGRAVISION

In a time of market disruption, NAGRAVISION will help you forge a path to success. We draw from more
than 30 years of experience with over 500 operators worldwide to create services and solutions that
succeed in protecting assets and supporting the ever-evolving business goals of our customer base
today.

From watermarking and anti-piracy solutions to streaming security, AI and analytics, we turn
entertainment and media technology into an engine of growth. Our solutions enable you to navigate a
dynamic environment to delight and retain existing subscribers, broaden the range of services
offered, discover new markets, and out-innovate the competition.


## Featured Products & Solutions

#### [Security Solutions][181]

Always-on, always-there security is core to our value proposition. It permeates our solutions and
gives you confidence that your content is always protected.

[ Find out more ][182]

#### [Streaming Solutions ][183]

Simplify the path to becoming a full-featured digital entertainment hub. Speed, efficiency, and
configuration are at the heart of a seamless streaming experience.

[ Find out more ][184]

#### [Subscriber Loyalty][185]

The power of data lies in the stories it tells. Digital twins – enriched by AI and designed for the
media and entertainment industry – give you the full picture on subscriber behavior.

[ Find out more ][186]

#### [Emerging Technologies][187]

Make sense of the disruption and future proof your business with media technology services that will
help your consumers thrive in their digital connected worlds.

[ Find out more ][188]

#### [Forensic Watermarking][189]

Combat piracy with the most powerful deterrent in the industry. Trace leaks back to the source and
protect valuable video and gaming content.

[ Find out more ][190]

#### [Anti-Piracy Services][191]

Piracy is popular, profitable, but preventable. Knowing who is stealing content or using operator
networks to distribute content illegally, gives you a crucial competitive advantage. 

[ Find out more ][192]

###### why us?

## The NAGRAVISION Difference

#### Market-Smart Techology

We combine cutting-edge technology with industry experience to deliver relevant solutions that
enable secure digital engagement. 

#### Engineering Excellence

Our Swiss roots and a focus on continuous innovation underpin our reputation for high-quality
industry–ready solutions.

#### Security First

As a pioneer in digital security, we help customers protect their content investments and help the
subscribers protect their connected worlds.

#### User-Centric

We focus on the consumer and creating- entertainment solutions that are easy to install, access, and
enjoy.

## TELUS revolutionizes Optik TV with Verimatrix

TELUS initiated Project OPUS to transform Optik TV, simplifying content interaction. They chose
Verimatrix Streamkeeper for robust security.

[ Find out more ][75]

## Challenges
* Flexibility, scalability
* North American presence
* Adapting to existing tech

## Solution

TELUS partnered with Verimatrix for hybrid cloud security, cost-effectiveness, and geo-diverse
services.

##  Benefits
* Cost-effective hybrid cloud
* Scalable, geo-diverse service
* Strong collaboration/migration

## Little Cinema Secures Streams with Verimatrix

Little Cinema Digital partnered with Verimatrix to secure pre-release content and deliver engaging
virtual premieres using Streamkeeper Multi-DRM and Watermarking.

[ Find out more ][76]
[ Play video ][77]

## Challenges
* Pre-integrate into Backstage platform
* Scalable high-profile Hollywood events
* Met studio protection standards

## Solution

Verimatrix’s security technology allowed Little Cinema to stream highly-anticipated video content to
a global audience, shaping the future of Hollywood.

##  Benefits
* 3M+ simulcast viewers
* 450+ secure events
* 1.2M+ platform attendees

## Swisscom Enhances Content Security with Verimatrix

Swisscom migrates from on-premises security to Verimatrix’s Video Content Authority System (VCAS™)
SaaS in the cloud.

[ Find out more ][78]

## Challenges
* On premises migration to cloud
* Maintaining scalability requirements
* Future-proofing against piracy

## Solution

Swisscom transited to the Verimatrix VCAS SaaS on AWS, leveraging the advantages of scaleable,
cloud-based anti-piracy operations.

##  Benefits
* Operational efficiencies
* Reliability and customizability
* Improved customer satisfaction

Vobile Group is a leading global platform
and service provider for digital content asset
protection and transactions

Based on its core patented technologies such as VDNA digital fingerprinting and digital
watermarking, Vobile has built a comprehensive system for digital content identification,
monitoring, and transaction services to protect copyrights and increase distribution revenue for
digital content asset owners, such as movie studios, TV networks, and streaming platforms. The Group
is committed to empowering the creative industries with leading technologies, building digital
infrastructure to support the value transfer of creative content, and serving global content
creators and related institutions in the Web3 era. The Group provides customers with efficient
professional solutions through subscription and value-added services, and has accumulated profound
technological strength and brand influence in the global media and entertainment industry.

Creativity is the core value of the content industry, and the protection and transaction of creative
content is the foundation to support the value chain. With the rise of generative AI technologies
and its impact on content production and distribution, we continue to strengthen our core
competitiveness in the digital content rights protection and transaction field to support our
clients to fully protect and maximize the core value of their digital content assets in the
ever-changing content era. We are committed to serving global content creators, and making creative
content more valuable.

One-stop Digital Content Rights Identification and Transaction Solutions
Vobile Group offers a comprehensive suite of solutions for digital content rights identification and
transactions, ensuring that the rights of creators are fully respected and protected. Our services
are designed to promote a broader and more transparent dissemination of creative content, aiding in
the fair representation of its value. This commitment underscores our dedication to empowering
creators and enhancing the visibility of their work in the digital realm.

*Whole Network Scanning*

Utilizing VDNA digital fingerprint technology, along with extensive scanning, to identify pirated
content worldwide and provide evidence to copyright owners.

[+ Learn More][28]

*Digital Rights Identification*

Applying our core patented digital watermark recognition technology to video streaming platforms,
providing unique identification features for original content.

[+ Learn More][29]

*Revenue Distribution*

Leveraging patented recognition technology and established business relationships with platforms, we
identify unauthorized use of content fragments or user-generated secondary creations on monetization
platforms. This enables copyright owners to reclaim their content rights and corresponding revenue.

[+ Learn More][30]

*Transaction Monetization*

By leveraging a distribution network and operational capabilities that encompass both long and short
video formats, we provide a vast amount of content with a revenue-sharing-based distribution and
monetization service, contingent on viewership results.

[+ Learn More][31]

Core Patent Technology:
Simplifying Rights Confirmation and Traceability for Content Creators

The VDNA fingerprint technology extracts key features from content, creating a unique fingerprint
for digital material.

Watermark technology enhances the ability to trace infringed content, achieving the tracking of
content distribution paths and origins.

Based on its core patented technologies such as VDNA digital fingerprinting and digital

monitoring, and transaction services to protect copyrights and increase distribution revenue for
digital content asset owners, such as movie studios, TV networks, and streaming platforms. The Group
is committed to empowering the creative industries with leading technologies, building digital
infrastructure to support the value transfer of creative content, and serving global content
creators and related institutions in the Web3 era. The Group provides customers with efficient
professional solutions through subscription and value-added services, and has accumulated profound
technological strength and brand influence in the global media and entertainment industry.

Creativity is the core value of the content industry, and the protection and transaction of creative
content is the foundation to support the value chain. With the rise of generative AI technologies
and its impact on content production and distribution, we continue to strengthen our core
competitiveness in the digital content rights protection and transaction field to support our
clients to fully protect and maximize the core value of their digital content assets in the
ever-changing content era. We are committed to serving global content creators, and making creative
content more valuable.

One-stop Digital Content Rights Identification and Transaction Solutions
Vobile Group offers a comprehensive suite of solutions for digital content rights identification and
transactions, ensuring that the rights of creators are fully respected and protected. Our services
are designed to promote a broader and more transparent dissemination of creative content, aiding in
the fair representation of its value. This commitment underscores our dedication to empowering
creators and enhancing the visibility of their work in the digital realm.

Utilizing VDNA digital fingerprint technology, along with extensive scanning, to identify pirated
content worldwide and provide evidence to copyright owners.

providing unique identification features for original content.

*Revenue Distribution*

Leveraging patented recognition technology and established business relationships with platforms, we
identify unauthorized use of content fragments or user-generated secondary creations on monetization
platforms. This enables copyright owners to reclaim their content rights and corresponding revenue.

for OTT and CAS services.

[Explore Solutions][24]
[No fees icon]

Widevine supports the use of standards-based royalty-free solutions for encryption, adaptive
streaming, transport and player software without licensing fees or required participation in the
CWIP training program.

[Play button icon]

Widevine provides a market-leading platform for delivering protected premium content at the highest
possible quality and is studio-approved for 4K, UHD, HDR and more.

[Globe icon]

Widevine supports the largest number of devices on the broadest number of chipsets and is currently
available on 5 billion mobile, desktop, set top box and living room devices.

The Certified Widevine Implementation Partner (CWIP) program is designed to allow highly qualified
individuals and companies the ability to confidently and successfully install and configure Widevine
systems for their clients.

## Discover Why Streaming Video Providers Choose Zype

“Zype is constantly thinking of new features for their users that are helpful and do a great job at
integrating these as core features of their product. They are able to find solutions that fit their
customers' business needs. Zype's product evolves around real world needs.”
Mark KirkSVP Director of Digital Operations, KONAMI
“Zype’s API is fantastic. It allowed our organization to automate many of our processes. Zype’s
platform makes it easy for us to share assets across websites and apps from a centralized system, so
we can optimize the impact of a single video. With a limited team of developers, Zype’s templated
apps were key in enabling us to launch on multiple endpoints and quickly expand our reach.”
Justin PetersonExecutive Director of IT at AWM
"The standout feature of Zype is their genuinely customer-centric approach. The support team is
incredibly responsive, knowledgeable, and feels like a true partner invested in our success, not
just a vendor. Beyond the fantastic people, the platform itself is powerful, easy to use and
comprehensive. Having a robust, all-in-one solution for our FAST channel management, from playout to
distribution, has been a significant upside. It simplifies complex workflows and has proven to be
incredibly reliable. We were able to seamlessly integrate Zype into our internal systems and
workflows, which made the daily use of the platform effortless."
Kate SturgessHead of 9Now Programming & Operations at Nine
"Zype offers an exceptionally user-friendly dashboard and comprehensive services for managing our
video content across various partner platforms. We have consistently experienced outstanding
customer service, and the development features provided have met and often exceeded our
expectations. The combination of intuitive functionality and responsive support has greatly enhanced
our ability to deliver high-quality video experiences to our audience."
Tom AndersonManager of Metadata & QA
“Zype’s Playout allowed Night Flight to build two distinct channels that we are able to update with
new programming each week. We have seen a huge shift to these channels in terms of viewing patterns
of our subscribers”
Stuart ShapiroFounder, Night Flight
“With the help of Zype, the launch of our first FAST channels has been seamless,” said Paul
Josephsen, chief strategy officer, WMX Media. “They provided an important tool to help us import and
manage our vast amount of content, and we are grateful for their continued support.”
WMXLaunch Press Release
“Using Zype Playout, we were able to implement an ‘Always-On strategy’ for YouTube. Zype Playout’s
ease of use allowed us to grow our main channel. After just six months, we increased our monthly
watch hours by 900%,”
Steven KeithChannel Manager, Spinmaster
“Through the development process, Zype listened to our needs as a premium video content provider
that has both an AVOD and SVOD business model. The early feedback has been tremendously positive
from our viewers.”
Ryan DaddSVP of Digital, Outside TV
"We have been fortunate to establish an embedded relationship with several facets of the Zype team
which has resulted in dynamic experiences for our viewers. As we continue to rapidly grow, we are
confident in the capabilities of the Zype solutions to grow with us.”
Christopher MohsCOO of SHG Living

organization in the nation, reaching millions across all backgrounds through its programs, services
and institutions. Our mission is to advance the health, economic, social, and cultural well-being of
all communities regionally and nationwide.

processes, reduce manual errors and optimize content exploitation & monetization.

# Futureproof Technology

Best of breed cloud native tech stack to reach the best performance in terms of speed, availability,
security and flexibility

## Cloud native

Designed to meet the most important properties of Cloud Native solutions: scalable, no-fault
infrastructure, zero virtual machines, secure, hot-deploy.

## API and workflow manager

Provides API entry point for creating, publishing, maintaining, monitoring, and securing REST and
WebSocket APIs and includes an async event and workflow components.

## Flexible data model

Support customer requests in terms of definition of new entities, attributes, vocabularies as well
as the interrelationships between business objects.

## Content Lifecycle Configuration

Allows specific user groups to manage actions, states and trigger external services. It guarantees
flexibilities and tailoring on customer internal  processes.

## Client configurable UI

Provides an editorial graphical presentation layer with a powerful rendering engine to configure the
UI and the dynamic layout.

[Contact us][43]

# Why Fincons

We are an experienced, international system integration & IT consulting group with unique expertise
in digital transformation for the Media industry.

For more than 40 years we have been working with tier 1 customers leveraging modern technologies and
tools (AI, ML, RPA, data lakes) alongside the implementation of legacy software (ERP, CRM, rights
management, ad sales etc.). This has helped us acquire relevant experience in supporting enterprise
clients to modernize their business management software and make it more business-outcome driven.

With offices in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the UK and the US., we leverage years of
experience implementing and customizing rights management software, taking a fresh look at this
space to come up with a new, fresh and hopefully innovative positioning to build a more data-driven
solution for content monetization and the associated process automation.

Choosing Fincons Group means selecting a business partner that is much more than just a vendor: we
are a system integrator offering a scalable product center and professional service resources,
helping you manage end-to-end project implementation along with ongoing support.

# Intellectual Property Attorneys in Tajikistan

We provide comprehensive legal services in the field of intellectual property, including patents,
trademarks, industrial designs, copyright, and IP enforcement. Our firm represents local and
international clients before the intellectual property authorities of the Republic of Tajikistan and
cooperates with international organizations under WIPO-administered systems.

[ Request a Consultation ][39]

* About bovari ip law

## Expert IP Representation
## in Tajikistan

Our firm is a full service intellectual property practice based in Tajikistan. We advise and
represent businesses, inventors, universities, and international companies on the protection,
management, and enforcement of intellectual property rights.

Our attorneys and patent agents are officially registered and authorized to act before the national
intellectual property authorities. We combine in depth knowledge of local legislation with
international IP standards to ensure effective and reliable protection of our clients’ innovations
and brands.

[ Learn More About us ][40]
* Services

## Intellectual Property Services in Tajikistan

Full-service patent and trademark attorneys representing local and international clients before the
intellectual property authorities of the Republic of Tajikistan.

### PATENTS

We provide full patent services in Tajikistan, including:
* Patent searches and patentability assessments
* Drafting and filing patent applications
* Prosecution before the patent office
* PCT national phase entry in Tajikistan
* Patent maintenance and renewals

### TRADEMARKS

Our trademark services include:
* Trademark searches and clearance
* Filing and registration
* Opposition and cancellation proceedings
* Recordal of assignments and licenses
* Trademark renewals

### INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS

We assist clients with:
* Design searches
* Filing and registration of industrial designs
* Renewal of registered industrial designs

### COPYRIGHT

We advise on copyright protection for:
* Literary and artistic works
* Software and databases
* Licensing and assignments

### IP STRATEGY & ENFORCEMENT

Our IP Strategy & Enforcement services include:
* IP portfolio management
* Infringement analysis, legal opinions and risk assessments
* Enforcement actions

[ Learn More ][41]

## why choose us

We combine deep local knowledge with international IP standards to ensure the reliable protection of
your innovations.

### Registered and authorized IP representatives in Tajikistan

### Experience with national and international IP filings

### Multilingual team (Tajik, Russian, English)

### Practical, business oriented legal advice

## How It Works

A simplified four-step process to secure and maintain your intellectual property rights in
Tajikistan.

### Initial Consultation

We assess your invention, brand, or design and advise on protection options.

### Filing

We prepare and file applications in accordance with Tajik legislation and international standards.

### Examination & Prosecution

We communicate with the IP office and respond to official actions.

### Registration & Maintenance

We support post registration matters, renewals, and enforcement.

## Ready to Protect Your Intellectual Property?

Contact our registered patent and trademark attorneys today to discuss your legal requirements in
Tajikistan.

[ Speak with an IP Specialist ][42]

## INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS

We regularly represent foreign applicants seeking IP protection in Tajikistan. Our firm acts as a
local agent for:
* PCT national phase applications
* Madrid trademark registrations
* Foreign design applications filed directly with the IP Office or via Hague Agreement

## We ensure compliance with all local requirements and provide clear guidance throughout the
## process.

### Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about intellectual property registration and legal protection in
Tajikistan.

Do foreign applicants need a local agent?

Yes. Foreign applicants must be represented by an authorized local IP agent in Tajikistan.

Are you particular about content security? Then we have some good news.

When you're buying Cloud DRM, what comes in the package goes beyond studio-approved video

[Visit bigbluemarble.com][36]

## Frequently Asked Questions

BasicsTechnologyDRM SystemsContent SecurityIntegrationsBusinessUser Experience
What is video DRM?

DRM (Digital Rights Management) is a technology that protects digital content from illegal copying,
downloading, and redistribution. It encrypts video and audio files so that only authorized users
with a valid license can watch them.

In the video and streaming industry, DRM is used by media platforms, broadcasters, sports rights
holders, and content distributors to control how, when, and on which devices viewers can access
their content.

How does DRM work?

DRM works in three steps:
1. During packaging, the video is encrypted with a cryptographic key
2. That key is stored securely on a DRM license server
3. When a user presses play, their video player sends a license request to the server. If the user
   is authorized — for example, they have an active subscription — the server sends back the
   decryption key, and the player unlocks and plays the video.

The whole process typically takes less than a second and is completely invisible to the viewer.

Why do I need DRM to protect my videos?

Without DRM, any viewer with access to your stream could freely download, copy, and share your
content. If you want to monetize your videos (whether your own or licensed), that poses a problem.

DRM also allows you to share your videos in a business model that depends on controlled access, such
as:
* Regular subscriptions that expire when a user cancels them
* Video rentals that expire after 48 hours
* Pay-per-View events with single-use tickets.

For platforms that distribute licensed or premium content — blockbuster movies, sports, professional
courses — DRM is often required by contract.

What are Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay — and what is the difference?

These are the three largest DRM systems that dominate the video streaming industry. Each of them is
owned by a different company and works with different platforms:
* **Google Widevine** — used on Chrome, Firefox, Android devices, Chromecast, most Android TVs and
  Smart TVs.
* **Microsoft PlayReady** — used on Windows, Microsoft Edge, Xbox, and some Smart TV platforms.
* **Apple FairPlay** — used exclusively on Apple platforms: Safari on macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and Apple
  TV. No third-party alternatives are allowed on Apple devices.

Because no single DRM covers all devices, any streaming platform that wants to reach all viewers
needs to implement all three.

What is Multi-DRM and why is it needed?

Multi-DRM means protecting your content with multiple DRM systems simultaneously, so that your
viewers can watch it on any device or browser.

Because Google Widevine, Apple FairPlay, and Microsoft PlayReady each work on different platforms, a
streaming service that only supports one of them will be unable to reach a large portion of its
audience. With Multi-DRM, the content is encrypted once using the Common Encryption (CENC) standard,
and the license server automatically delivers the right license for whatever device the viewer is
using.

From the viewer's perspective, it is seamless — they just press play, and it works on any device.

  MediaPackage, Anevia, Unified Streaming, and Wowza Media Engine. Supports SPEKE v.2 and CPIX.

### Player integrations
* Integrates with any DRM-compatible player, including ExoPlayer, dash.js, Shaka Player, Bitmovin,
  THEOPlayer, JWPlayer, iOS AVPlayer and more

### SLA
* Up to 99,995%

[Big Blue Marble event]

## Powered by Big Blue Marble

Are you particular about content security? Then we have some good news.

When you're buying Cloud DRM, what comes in the package goes beyond studio-approved video
encryption. What you are also getting are over 20 years of streaming experience; teams of engineers
managing and securing global-scale broadcasts every day; and experts dedicated to protecting video
content even as piracy continues to rise and generative AI is reshaping the game.

This is what our brand, **Big Blue Marble**, stands for. Visit our main site to learn more about the
companies behind it and how we help broadcasters, sports organizations, content publishers, and
public sector companies bring their videos to millions of viewers each day.

[Visit bigbluemarble.com][36]

## Frequently Asked Questions

BasicsTechnologyDRM SystemsContent SecurityIntegrationsBusinessUser Experience
What is video DRM?

DRM (Digital Rights Management) is a technology that protects digital content from illegal copying,
downloading, and redistribution. It encrypts video and audio files so that only authorized users
with a valid license can watch them.

In the video and streaming industry, DRM is used by media platforms, broadcasters, sports rights
holders, and content distributors to control how, when, and on which devices viewers can access
their content.

How does DRM work?

DRM works in three steps:
1. During packaging, the video is encrypted with a cryptographic key
2. That key is stored securely on a DRM license server
3. When a user presses play, their video player sends a license request to the server. If the user
   is authorized — for example, they have an active subscription — the server sends back the
   decryption key, and the player unlocks and plays the video.

The whole process typically takes less than a second and is completely invisible to the viewer.

Why do I need DRM to protect my videos?

Without DRM, any viewer with access to your stream could freely download, copy, and share your
content. If you want to monetize your videos (whether your own or licensed), that poses a problem.

DRM also allows you to share your videos in a business model that depends on controlled access, such
as:
* Regular subscriptions that expire when a user cancels them
* Video rentals that expire after 48 hours
* Pay-per-View events with single-use tickets.

For platforms that distribute licensed or premium content — blockbuster movies, sports, professional
courses — DRM is often required by contract.

What are Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay — and what is the difference?

These are the three largest DRM systems that dominate the video streaming industry. Each of them is
owned by a different company and works with different platforms:
* **Google Widevine** — used on Chrome, Firefox, Android devices, Chromecast, most Android TVs and
  Smart TVs.
* **Microsoft PlayReady** — used on Windows, Microsoft Edge, Xbox, and some Smart TV platforms.
* **Apple FairPlay** — used exclusively on Apple platforms: Safari on macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and Apple
  TV. No third-party alternatives are allowed on Apple devices.

Because no single DRM covers all devices, any streaming platform that wants to reach all viewers
needs to implement all three.

What is Multi-DRM and why is it needed?

Multi-DRM means protecting your content with multiple DRM systems simultaneously, so that your
viewers can watch it on any device or browser.

Because Google Widevine, Apple FairPlay, and Microsoft PlayReady each work on different platforms, a
streaming service that only supports one of them will be unable to reach a large portion of its
audience. With Multi-DRM, the content is encrypted once using the Common Encryption (CENC) standard,
and the license server automatically delivers the right license for whatever device the viewer is
using.

From the viewer's perspective, it is seamless — they just press play, and it works on any device.

# Overview

Copy pageCopy page

Discover what Notion connections are, when to use each type, and what you can build.

Copy pageCopy page

## [
## ][41]
## Using Notion API

Notion connections let you connect your workspace to external tools and automate workflows through
code. With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages,
databases, users, comments, and more. When you create a connection, you define what it can do: which
API endpoints it can call, what content it can read or write, and how it authenticates. Each
connection gets its own credentials and its own set of permissions.

## [
## ][42]
## What is a Notion connection?

A Notion [connection][43] — sometimes called an integration — connects your workspace to external
apps and tools. That could be a SaaS product, an automation script, or a custom tool you’ve built.
Connections are added to Notion workspaces and require **explicit permission** from users to access
Notion pages and databases.

Create Notion connections that unlock new possibilities for teams.

Notion already has a [library][44] of connections you can browse. For developers who want to build
their own, Notion supports internal connections, public connections, and personal access tokens —
all powered by the same REST API.

## [
## ][45]
## Connection types

Notion supports three authentication models:
* **Internal connections** are scoped to a single workspace and use a static API token. They’re
  ideal for custom automations and workflows — things like syncing data, sending notifications, or
  building internal dashboards.
* **Public connections** use OAuth 2.0 for authentication. At creation time, you choose their
  [installation scope][46]: **Any workspace** (any Notion user can install; Marketplace-eligible) or
  **Selected workspaces only** (restricted to workspaces you select; not Marketplace-eligible).
* **Personal access tokens (PATs)** are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and
  tools that should act as one Notion user. A PAT uses the creator’s workspace membership and page
  permissions. See [Personal access tokens][47].
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being [listed on the
Marketplace][48]. You can create and use a public connection without listing it.

## Using Notion API

Notion connections let you connect your workspace to external tools and automate workflows through
code. With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages,
databases, users, comments, and more. When you create a connection, you define what it can do: which
API endpoints it can call, what content it can read or write, and how it authenticates. Each
connection gets its own credentials and its own set of permissions.

## [
## ][42]
## What is a Notion connection?

A Notion [connection][43] — sometimes called an integration — connects your workspace to external
apps and tools. That could be a SaaS product, an automation script, or a custom tool you’ve built.
Connections are added to Notion workspaces and require **explicit permission** from users to access
Notion pages and databases.

Create Notion connections that unlock new possibilities for teams.

Notion already has a [library][44] of connections you can browse. For developers who want to build
their own, Notion supports internal connections, public connections, and personal access tokens —
all powered by the same REST API.

## [
## ][45]
## Connection types

Notion supports three authentication models:
* **Internal connections** are scoped to a single workspace and use a static API token. They’re
  ideal for custom automations and workflows — things like syncing data, sending notifications, or
  building internal dashboards.
* **Public connections** use OAuth 2.0 for authentication. At creation time, you choose their
  [installation scope][46]: **Any workspace** (any Notion user can install; Marketplace-eligible) or
  **Selected workspaces only** (restricted to workspaces you select; not Marketplace-eligible).
* **Personal access tokens (PATs)** are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and
  tools that should act as one Notion user. A PAT uses the creator’s workspace membership and page
  permissions. See [Personal access tokens][47].
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being [listed on the
Marketplace][48]. You can create and use a public connection without listing it.

## Shared concepts

All connection and token types share a few core concepts.

### [
### ][51]
### Capabilities

Every connection or token has a set of capabilities that control what it can do — read content,
update content, insert content, read comments, and more. You configure capabilities when you create
a connection or PAT. See the [Capabilities reference][52] for the full list.

## Pages

Create, update, and retrieve page content.

## Databases

Manage database, properties, entries, and schemas.

## Views

Create and configure database views programmatically.

## Data sources

Manage data sources, properties, entries, and schemas.

## File uploads

Upload and attach files to pages and databases.

## Comments

Handle page and inline comments.

## Content queries

Search through workspace content.

## Users

Access user profiles and permissions.

### [
### ][53]
### Content access

Connections must have access to pages and databases before they can interact with them. The
mechanism differs by type:
* **Internal connections** can be granted access in two ways: the connection owner can add pages
  directly from the **Content access** tab in the Developer portal, or workspace members can share
  pages via the **Add connections** menu in Notion.
* **Public connections** use the OAuth page picker, where users select which pages to grant access
  to during the authorization flow.
* **Personal access tokens** use the token creator’s existing Notion permissions. If the creator can
  access a page in Notion, a PAT with the right capabilities can access it through the API.
See the [Internal connections][54], [Public connections][55], and [Personal access tokens][56]
guides for specifics on how content access works for each type.

### [
### ][57]
### Webhooks

Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new
comments — via webhooks. This allows your connection to react to changes in Notion without polling
the API. See the [Webhooks guide][58] for details on setting up webhook subscriptions.

FADEL empowers brands to make the most of their content and licensed properties

### Brand Vision

Track your content and content rights for brand protection across your content workflow

[Protect Your Brand][69]

Automate rights and royalty management across the licensing lifecycle from concept to creation

Streamline royalty operations, strengthen licensing partnerships, and get back to the business of
creativity

and transform business operations

### Marketing

Accelerate campaign creation, maximize asset reuse, and avoid penalties for content misuse.

[Accelerate Your Content Production][73]

Generate royalty statements, audit reports, forecasts, and AI analytics at the click of a button

[Transform Your Royalty Operations][74]

### Licensing Professionals

Optimize revenue, identify licensing violations, and avoid over/under royalty payments

[Get Better Licensing Data][75]

### Editorial & Sales

Centralize live photo feeds, digital assets, and articles for editorial and syndication

## What Is FileOpen?

FileOpen document rights management is a flexible SaaS system for encrypting and authenticating
digital documents at scale. Built upon standard document formats and application security
frameworks, FileOpen allows you to deploy enterprise-grade document security with a lightweight
footprint for both administrators and end-users.

## For over 20 years, FileOpen has been trusted by organizations worldwide for the most demanding
## digital publishing use cases

### Businesses

[Companies of all sizes][43] use FileOpen to protect sensitive information with external partners
and customers outside the corporate firewall. FileOpen allows companies to assign detailed
permission policies to outside groups with the ability to revoke or change access even after
delivery.

### Publishers

High-volume digital [publishers][44] rely on FileOpen to protect and enforce their copyright around

FortySeven Software Professionals, founded in 2006, is a leading IT consulting, IT staffing and
software company. Certified with ISO 271001 and ISO 9001.

#### Scalable Software Engineering

FortySeven provides a high standard of software development services, IT consulting and IT staffing

Web3.

#### Advanced Methodologies

FortySeven’ developers and teams use advanced technologies and implement many years of expertise to
customize services for our customers' needs. We use management tools to provide you with total
transparency.

#### **Adjustable Engagement Models**

FortySeven offers flexible developers to meet your divergent needs and create a positive impact on
their rapidly evolving business. You can hire IT specialist with missing expertise quickly and
easily.

#### Deep Technology Expertise

FortySeven’ industry knowledge allows us to deliver solutions that solve business challenges in 40+
industries. Working closely with you, we define your needs and devise effective automation tool

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## Employees and AI Agents Face the Same Regulatory Requirements.

Every compliance framework — HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, PCI-DSS, IRAP — regulates data access, not who
performs it. Whether it’s an employee or an AI agent, the same controls apply.

### Kiteworks
### Solves Both.

One governance layer for employees and AI agents. No new platform, no data migration — just
compliance where the data already lives.

[Employee]
Employee

Employees share sensitive files via email, cloud folders, and managed file transfers, often across
organizational boundaries.

Kiteworks enforces one Data Policy Engine across every channel — email, SFTP, web forms, and desktop
sync — so compliance teams set a rule once and it applies everywhere.

Kiteworks consolidates all activity into a single, normalized audit log — searchable, filterable,
and SIEM-ready — so regulator evidence production is fast and automated.

Kiteworks replaces shadow IT with a secure, policy-governed platform for every file exchange —
eliminating blind spots with continuous, real-time visibility instead of waiting for the next audit.

←

[AI Agent]
AI Agent

AI agents authenticate as the human who set them up. Your audit trail can’t distinguish agent
actions from human actions.

Kiteworks’ MCP Server enforces RBAC and ABAC governance on every AI operation — agents receive
scoped, least-privilege access aligned with regulatory compliance requirements.

Every file an AI agent uploads or creates passes through Kiteworks’ metadata scanning, data
classification, and ABAC policy enforcement — derivative works inherit the same governance as any
human-created content.

Kiteworks is purpose-built to enforce identity, policy, encryption, and audit on every AI agent data
interaction — through its Secure MCP Server, OAuth 2.0 authentication, and comprehensive audit
logging.

←

Unified Governance Framework

## Four Controls. Every Accessor.
## Full Compliance.

Most organizations use fragmented tools for email security, file sharing, MFT, and now AI
governance. Kiteworks unifies all data exchange under a single compliance framework.

[Authenticated Identity]

### Authenticated Identity

Employees authenticate via SAML, MFA, and certificates. Agents authenticate with scoped delegation
tokens carrying both agent and human identity.

[Policy-Enforced Access]

### Policy-Enforced Access

ABAC Data Policy Engine evaluates every operation — considering data classification, user or agent
profile, action type, and context — before permitting access.

[Encrypted Handling]

### Encrypted Handling

TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, FIPS 140-3 validated modules. FedRAMP authorized. On-premises
and hybrid deployment for data sovereignty.

[Complete Audit Trail]

### Complete Audit Trail

Every data interaction — human or agent — is logged with identity, action, file, policy evaluated,
and outcome. Tamper-evident. SIEM-integrated. Auditor-ready.

### Data Policy Engine (DPE)

ABAC and RBAC controls enforce authorization based on data classification, user attributes, accessor
type, and context — for both employees and agents.

[Retention and Expiration]

### Retention & Expiration

Expire files, folders, and email links after configurable time periods. Automatic retention
policies, deletion grace periods, and content withdrawal.

[Multi-Factor Authentication]

### Multi-Factor Authentication

RADIUS, PIV/CAC, SAML, email OTP, SMS OTP, certificate-based auth, and internally managed
credentials protect every human access point.

[Classification-Aware Decisions]

### Classification-Aware Decisions

Access decisions respect MIP sensitivity labels and classification tags. Agents read metadata before
downloading; ABAC enforces restrictions independently.

[Scoped Delegation Tokens]

### Scoped Delegation Tokens

AI agents receive only the access their task requires — restricted to specific folders, operations,
and time windows — not the delegating user’s full permission set.

[Admin Role Separation]

### Admin Role Separation

Separation of duties ensures administrators and compliance officers see only data appropriate to
their role and regulatory requirements.

[TLS 1.3 Encryption]

### TLS 1.3 Encryption

All data in transit is secured using TLS 1.3, the latest encryption standard, ensuring protection
against eavesdropping during file transfers and API communications.

### AES-256 Encryption

Files and metadata are encrypted at rest using AES-256, safeguarding stored data from unauthorized
access and breaches.

### FIPS 140-3 Validated

Cryptographic modules are FIPS 140-3 validated, ensuring compliance with U.S. government and
regulated industry standards.

### DLP Integration

Seamless integration with DLP providers via ICAP enables automated scanning of sensitive data and
enforcement of policy-based controls.

[Malware Scanning]

### Malware Scanning

All incoming files are scanned for malware before storage, protecting systems and users from
malicious threats.

[On-Premises Deployment]

### On-Premises Deployment

Deploy entirely on your own infrastructure for maximum data control, supporting air-gapped
environments and strict regulatory compliance.

[Immutable Audit Logs]

### Immutable Audit Logs

Every file access, transfer, and policy decision is recorded in a tamper-evident, immutable audit
trail for full accountability.

[SIEM Integration]

### SIEM Integration

Push audit events directly to your SIEM systems like Splunk, QRadar, and ArcSight for centralized
monitoring and threat detection.

[Compliance Reports]

### Compliance Reports

Generate pre-built reports for HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, and PCI DSS using unified audit logs to simplify
regulatory compliance.

[Agent Action Tracking]

### Agent Action Tracking

Track AI agent operations with full visibility into delegation chains, task context, and policy
evaluation outcomes.

regulated industry standards.

[DLP Integration]

### DLP Integration

Seamless integration with DLP providers via ICAP enables automated scanning of sensitive data and
enforcement of policy-based controls.

[Malware Scanning]

### Malware Scanning

All incoming files are scanned for malware before storage, protecting systems and users from
malicious threats.

[On-Premises Deployment]

### On-Premises Deployment

Deploy entirely on your own infrastructure for maximum data control, supporting air-gapped
environments and strict regulatory compliance.

[Immutable Audit Logs]

### Immutable Audit Logs

Every file access, transfer, and policy decision is recorded in a tamper-evident, immutable audit
trail for full accountability.

[SIEM Integration]

### SIEM Integration

Push audit events directly to your SIEM systems like Splunk, QRadar, and ArcSight for centralized
monitoring and threat detection.

[Compliance Reports]

### Compliance Reports

Generate pre-built reports for HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, and PCI DSS using unified audit logs to simplify
regulatory compliance.

[Agent Action Tracking]

### Agent Action Tracking

Track AI agent operations with full visibility into delegation chains, task context, and policy
evaluation outcomes.

[CISO Dashboard]

Роскосмос Байконур (Казахстан)
Авиакосмическая промышленность
Изыскательские работы, проектирование, оформление разрешений на использование радиочастот, поставка
оборудования, монтаж и настройка, обучение персонала, сервисная, гарантийная и постгарантийная

][53] [
Лукойл. МЛСП им. Ю. Корчагина
Нефтегазовая промышленность
Специалистами компании ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ была запроектирована система связи, удовлетворяющая всем
вышеуказанным требованиям. Произведена поставка оборудования, монтаж, пуско-наладочные работы и ввод
в эксплуатацию системы профессиональной цифровой транкинговой радиосвязи на базе оборудования
Kenwood Nexedge. Произведена сертификация взрывобезопасного абонентского оборудования.
Распределенная система АФУ покрывает все зоны платформы, включая внутренние, труднодоступные для
проникновения радиосигнала, помещения.
][54] [
Авианосец "Адмирал Горшков" - "Викрамадитья"
Морской флот
Система бортовой связи стандарта NXDN на базе оборудования Kenwood Nexedge была разработана и
внедрена специалистами ЗАО «ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ» совместно со специалистами ОАО «Муромский радиозавод».
Установлены 8 цифровых ретрансляторов, система записи переговоров, произведена интеграция с бортовой
системой громкоговорящей связи и оповещения. Разработан абонентский комплект, состоящий из цифровой
радиостанции, спецчехла и шумозащищенной гарнитуры.
][55]

# calibre User Manual[¶][40]

calibre is an e-book library manager. It can view, convert and catalog e-books in most of the major
e-book formats. It can also talk to many e-book reader devices. It can go out to the Internet and
fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for
convenient reading. It is cross platform, running on Linux, Windows and macOS.

You’ve just started calibre. What do you do now? Before calibre can do anything with your e-books,
it first has to know about them. Drag and drop a few e-book files into calibre, or click the “Add
books” button and browse for the e-books you want to work with. Once you’ve added the books, they
will show up in the main view looking something like this:

[_images/added_books.png]

Once you’ve admired the list of books you just added to your heart’s content, you’ll probably want
to read one. In order to do that you’ll have to convert the book to a format your reader
understands. When first running calibre, the Welcome wizard starts and will set up calibre for your
reader device. Conversion is a breeze. Just select the book you want to convert then click the
“Convert books” button. Ignore all the options for now and click “OK”. The little icon in the bottom
right corner will start spinning. Once it’s finished spinning, your converted book is ready. Click
the “View” button to read the book.

If you want to read the book on your reader, connect the reader to the computer, wait till calibre
detects it (10-20 seconds) and then click the “Send to device” button. Once the icon stops spinning
again, disconnect your reader and read away! If you didn’t convert the book in the previous step,
calibre will auto convert it to the format your reader device understands.

To get started with more advanced usage, you should read about [The Graphical User Interface][41].
For even more power and versatility, learn the [Command Line Interface][42]. You will find the list
of [Frequently Asked Questions][43] useful as well.

If you have more questions, or want to discuss calibre with other users or ask for help with
specific things, there are [forums and other help resources available][44].

**An e-book version of this User Manual is available in** [EPUB format][45], [AZW3 (Kindle)
format][46] and [PDF format][47].

# calibre User Manual[¶][40]

calibre is an e-book library manager. It can view, convert and catalog e-books in most of the major
e-book formats. It can also talk to many e-book reader devices. It can go out to the Internet and
fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for
convenient reading. It is cross platform, running on Linux, Windows and macOS.

You’ve just started calibre. What do you do now? Before calibre can do anything with your e-books,
it first has to know about them. Drag and drop a few e-book files into calibre, or click the “Add
books” button and browse for the e-books you want to work with. Once you’ve added the books, they
will show up in the main view looking something like this:

[_images/added_books.png]

Once you’ve admired the list of books you just added to your heart’s content, you’ll probably want
to read one. In order to do that you’ll have to convert the book to a format your reader
understands. When first running calibre, the Welcome wizard starts and will set up calibre for your
reader device. Conversion is a breeze. Just select the book you want to convert then click the
“Convert books” button. Ignore all the options for now and click “OK”. The little icon in the bottom
right corner will start spinning. Once it’s finished spinning, your converted book is ready. Click
the “View” button to read the book.

If you want to read the book on your reader, connect the reader to the computer, wait till calibre
detects it (10-20 seconds) and then click the “Send to device” button. Once the icon stops spinning
again, disconnect your reader and read away! If you didn’t convert the book in the previous step,
calibre will auto convert it to the format your reader device understands.

To get started with more advanced usage, you should read about [The Graphical User Interface][41].
For even more power and versatility, learn the [Command Line Interface][42]. You will find the list
of [Frequently Asked Questions][43] useful as well.

If you have more questions, or want to discuss calibre with other users or ask for help with
specific things, there are [forums and other help resources available][44].

format][46] and [PDF format][47].

Common questions

## Before you **ask.**

Why work with an agency instead of building the team in-house?

Sometimes in-house is the right answer, and we’ll tell you when it is — we also build and train
internal YouTube teams and hand over the keys. An agency earns its place when you need senior
operators running the channel now, without an 18-month hiring cycle, and a bench deep enough to
cover strategy, editing, ads, and rights in one place.

How do you report?

Weekly, in language a board reads. Every metric ties back to a business goal you set at the start —
pipeline influence, share of voice, watch time on the videos that matter — not vanity counts. Your
marketing lead can forward the report upward without rewriting it.

Who owns the channel, the footage, and the accounts?

You do, always. The channel, the raw footage, the analytics access, and every asset we produce stay
in your accounts and your name. There are no lock-ins — we re-earn the retainer every month, and if
you leave, you leave with everything.

Can you handle copyright claims, takedowns, and impersonators?

Yes. We manage copyright claims and counter-claims, file DMCA takedowns, administer Content ID, and
monitor for re-uploads and impersonating channels, with escalation paths into YouTube. On an
enterprise channel it’s a standing part of the job, not an afterthought.

Do you replace our existing agencies, or work alongside them?

Either. Some clients hand us the channel end to end; others plug us in beside a brand studio, a PR
firm, or a paid-media agency, and we own only the YouTube surface. We scope the boundary clearly so
nothing falls between teams.

What does an engagement cost?

It’s scoped to your channel and goals after a strategy call. The shape depends on cadence, how much
we run versus build with your team, and whether brand protection and ads are in scope. Book a call
and a senior strategist will map it out.

Common questions

## Before you **ask.**

Why work with an agency instead of building the team in-house?

Sometimes in-house is the right answer, and we’ll tell you when it is — we also build and train
internal YouTube teams and hand over the keys. An agency earns its place when you need senior
operators running the channel now, without an 18-month hiring cycle, and a bench deep enough to
cover strategy, editing, ads, and rights in one place.

How do you report?

Weekly, in language a board reads. Every metric ties back to a business goal you set at the start —
pipeline influence, share of voice, watch time on the videos that matter — not vanity counts. Your
marketing lead can forward the report upward without rewriting it.

Who owns the channel, the footage, and the accounts?

You do, always. The channel, the raw footage, the analytics access, and every asset we produce stay
in your accounts and your name. There are no lock-ins — we re-earn the retainer every month, and if
you leave, you leave with everything.

Can you handle copyright claims, takedowns, and impersonators?

Yes. We manage copyright claims and counter-claims, file DMCA takedowns, administer Content ID, and
monitor for re-uploads and impersonating channels, with escalation paths into YouTube. On an
enterprise channel it’s a standing part of the job, not an afterthought.

Do you replace our existing agencies, or work alongside them?

Either. Some clients hand us the channel end to end; others plug us in beside a brand studio, a PR
firm, or a paid-media agency, and we own only the YouTube surface. We scope the boundary clearly so
nothing falls between teams.

What does an engagement cost?

It’s scoped to your channel and goals after a strategy call. The shape depends on cadence, how much
we run versus build with your team, and whether brand protection and ads are in scope. Book a call
and a senior strategist will map it out.

Enter smart software license management

### Do what matters the most

Monitoring Analytics Optimization

### Real-time consumption views

Get immediate visibility into license availability by user and machine. This helps identify idle
sessions and monitor details such as license type, tokens consumed, and borrowed status.

### Granular application and process monitoring

Track the usage of applications, specific features, and DLLs to gain insights down to the
application add-in level.

### Dongle and offline tracking

Monitor physical USB dongle license keys connected to PCs to track their location and usage
frequency. The system captures usage data even when the device is disconnected from the network,
providing an accurate view for remote workers.

### Historical usage and allocation auditing

Track logs of every license check-out and check-in. This allows analysis of historical usage
patterns to determine who used what license, when, from where, and for how long.

### Denial tracking and management

Tracks and analyzes failed license requests (denials). This provides instant visibility into the
cause, user, and lost productivity duration.

### Strategic and financial analytics

Get high-level insights for optimizing contracts. It also offers Cost and Chargeback capabilities to
accurately align software expenses with specific projects, departments, or cost centers for
transparent financial governance.

### Automated license harvesting

Reclaim idle licenses automatically to make them available for other users. Thus, you can prevent
wastage of expensive licenses and prioritize efficiency.

### Subscription optimization

Automate reassignment of engineering SaaS named-user seats based on actual usage (e.g: Autodesk
Cloud).

### License Access Control (LAC) and policy enforcement

Manage and restrict access to licenses within the organization. Customize license access policies
for specific users and groups to ensure fair usage.

Monitor physical USB dongle license keys connected to PCs to track their location and usage

wastage of expensive licenses and prioritize efficiency.

**About Us**

Pratham Books is a not-for-profit children’s book publisher that was set up in 2004 to publish good
quality, affordable books in many Indian languages. Our mission is to see ‘a book in every child’s
hand’ and we have spread the joy of reading to millions of children in India. As a publisher serving
every child in India, Pratham Books has always pushed the boundaries when it comes to exploring
innovative ways in which to create access to joyful stories and has been fortunate in finding
partners to collaborate with who share this vision.

In 2015, Pratham Books increased its footprint by going digital. As an industry leader, we were one
of the first publishers in the country to open up our content to the CC0 license. All this content
is now available on [StoryWeaver][91], a digital platform that hosts stories in languages from India
and beyond so that every child can have an endless stream of stories in her mother tongue to read
and enjoy. All the stories on the platform can be read, translated, versioned or downloaded for
free.

 

**Job Description:**

Today, Pratham Books creates books suited to both print and digital mediums in multiple languages.
We are looking for an Associate Art Director to help us create visually appealing picture books with
a strong understanding of how each of these mediums work.

As an Associate Art Director, you will be responsible for the design and production of books created
for both print and digital mediums. As most of our titles are migrated to StoryWeaver, we are
looking for someone who is tech-savvy and eager to find ways of minimising loss between print and
digital book design. This will require you to work closely with our editorial team and external
content creators we collaborate with (illustrators, consultant art directors). The candidate needs
to have excellent graphic design skills and experience in print production.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Work with freelance illustrators and consultant art directors to create visually-appealing books
  keeping in mind print and digital requirements.
* Ensure that books are completed within the required timelines for print and digital mediums.
* Art direct 10 books a year by working directly with illustrators.
* Find innovative ways of reducing losses when a book is adapted from print to digital, or vice
  versa.
* Ensure the highest quality of print books.
* Work closely with the editorial team to create stories with rich, diverse and nuanced visual
  narratives.
* Bring in the expertise of typography, keeping in mind multilingual content.

 

**Required skills:**
* At least 4 years of experience in Graphic Design.
* Strong understanding of print production and typography.
* Strong communication skills.
* Expertise in Photoshop and InDesign.
* Ability to multitask.
* Be a team player.

**Nice to have but not mandatory:**
* An interest in illustration and book publishing.
* Knowledge of children’s books.

**Location: **This is a full-time position based out of either Bangalore or Delhi.

*We would ideally, however, prefer that the candidate be based in Delhi with the rest of the team.

**Compensation: ** Salary will be commensurate with experience. We are looking for a passionate
individual who wants to be part of a team that is creating a new model in multilingual publishing to
address the scarcity of books for children in need.

 

**Write to us: **

Email your resume with **‘Associate Art Director’ **in the subject line to
**[[email protected]][92]**.

CLOSE

## Music Royalty Collection & Rights Management

Your one-stop platform for copyright control and royalty collection. Manage and monetise your music,
easily.
* Register your works with ease
* Upload setlists for live performances
* Track global earnings in real time
* Expert help from industry professionals
* Access your dashboard 24/7
* Retain 100% royalties

[ Explore Pricing ][14]

## Start Managing
## in Minutes

Upload your songs, register your rights, and track your royalties in minutes. Simple setup. Keep
100% of your royalties.

[ Start Managing ][15]

## Performance Royalties

We help you collect royalties from live and broadcast performances worldwide.
* Performed live at a club, festival?
* Or even a livestream?

[ Explore Pricing & Plans ][16]

## Don’t Miss Out on Global Royalties

Your music could be making money all over the world. We help you collect it, wherever it comes from.

## Global Royalty Collection Network

Rightsbridge works with collection societies worldwide to identify, track, and claim royalties on
your behalf.

## What Money Are You Missing Out On?

Every year, artists lose millions in unclaimed royalties. Rightsbridge’s music royalty collection
system helps you track, claim, and collect what you earn. 

### Neighbouring Rights


Even if you didn’t write the song, you may still earn royalties. Neighbouring rights pay performers,
producers, and rights-holders for their role in bringing music to life.
* Performed on the track?
* Produced or distributed the recording?

### Live Performance Royalties


PROs collect venue fees for live music but only pay when they know who performed. Simply submit your
set lists to your Rightsbridge dashboard to get credited and compensated.
* Set list submissions for live shows
* Venue performance tracking

### Mechanical Royalties


Mechanical royalties are paid to songwriters, composers, and publishers whenever a song is
reproduced physically or digitally. This includes streams, downloads, CDs, and vinyl.
* Wrote or co-wrote the song?
* Own the publishing rights?

## What Does Rightsbridge Do?

We empower music professionals with smart rights management and comprehensive music royalty
collection services.

### Copyright Management

Focus on the music. Let us handle the paperwork.

### Real-Time Dashboard Access

Monitor earnings and reports anytime, anywhere.

### Live Show Royalty Claims

Upload your setlist. We’ll handle the rest.

### Manage Multiple Catalogues

Manage solo work, band rosters, label releases, or publishing portfolios.

### Advanced Analytics

See how your music earns money, across platforms and territories.

### Expert Support

Get help when you need it - from copyright to royalties.

## Got Questions?

Can we register my music with collection societies?

Yes. We register your works and recordings with the relevant copyright collection societies on your
behalf, ensuring accurate metadata and proper registration.

How is pricing structured?

We offer four pricing tiers based on how many people you're managing rights for - from £50/year for
individuals up to £500/year for companies managing multiple creators. See full pricing [here][21].

What kind of support can I expect?

We provide personalised assistance via email and in-platform - whether it’s a quick question or help
with complex copyright issues, our experts are here for you. 

Can I manage multiple catalogues with one account?

Yes. If you're managing works for multiple creators, Rightsbridge allows you to organise and track
all catalogues from one place.

How do I get started?

Simply choose the membership tier that suits your needs and [sign up][22]. If you have questions
before joining, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help.

Rightsbridge works with collection societies worldwide to identify, track, and claim royalties on
your behalf.

## What Money Are You Missing Out On?

Every year, artists lose millions in unclaimed royalties. Rightsbridge’s music royalty collection
system helps you track, claim, and collect what you earn. 

### Neighbouring Rights


Even if you didn’t write the song, you may still earn royalties. Neighbouring rights pay performers,
producers, and rights-holders for their role in bringing music to life.
* Performed on the track?

### Live Performance Royalties


PROs collect venue fees for live music but only pay when they know who performed. Simply submit your
set lists to your Rightsbridge dashboard to get credited and compensated.
* Set list submissions for live shows
* Venue performance tracking

### Mechanical Royalties


Mechanical royalties are paid to songwriters, composers, and publishers whenever a song is
reproduced physically or digitally. This includes streams, downloads, CDs, and vinyl.
* Wrote or co-wrote the song?

# Hacking and Auditing

A hands-on course to hack and audit smart contracts. Learn EVM fundamentals, real exploit practice,
and AI-assisted audit workflows, all within a proven framework.

[ Start the Program ][89] [ Learn More ][90]
[JohnnyTime Smart Contract Auditing Instructor] Created by **JohnnyTime**

## Become The Auditor Protocols Hire

One focused program that turns you into a paid smart contract auditor, with the skills and the
credentials to prove it.

319 Videos 33 hours of self-paced learning, covering every major attack vector
50+ Hands-On Labs Guided CTF exercises on real contracts, directly in course labs
SSCH Certification An on-chain verifiable certificate you can share with firms and clients

## 3 things you walk away with

The fair question before any course is what you actually get for the money. These are the three
capabilities that the program delivers that separate a paid auditor from a developer who just reads
Solidity.

01

### The Skills

You'll master every major attack class, so you can navigate, critically analyze, and deconstruct any
contract, instead of just matching it to bugs you've seen before.

02

### The Connections

From instructors, who are some of the best auditors in the field, to hiring managers and fellow
students who later become colleagues, contest partners and audit buddies.

03

### The Proof

A score-backed certification that shows exactly how much you know. It's the credential hiring firms
and contest organizers actually take seriously.

Top auditors protect billions in on-chain value, and they get paid to find the bugs that would've
cost fortunes.

* ✓ Strong market reputation potential

### Upload Your Manuscript With A Few Clicks
* Easily upload your manuscript using Spines’ user-friendly dashboard. Just fill in a few simple
  details, like the book title, author’s name, and category.

### AI-Powered Manuscript Scans for Smarter Editing
* Spines scans your manuscript using built-in AI to understand your audience, genre, and writing
  style. It then automatically identifies grammar mistakes and areas for improvement—making the
  editing process faster and smarter.
* If needed, you can also connect with professional editors for an added layer of refinement.

[ Get Started ][33]

### Custom Covers Tailored to Your Book & Style
* Choose from a wide range of custom-made cover designs, tailored to your book and personal style
  preferences. If you already have a cover, we can enhance it with our cover tool - or simply upload
  and use your own.
* Customize your book’s interior formatting in real time to match your style and genre.

[ Get Started ][34]

### Publish Easily & Reach Readers Worldwide
* Hit publish, and Spines takes care of the rest. Your book will be distributed across major
  platforms, reaching readers worldwide.
* Set up automatic ad campaigns on Amazon, Facebook, and Instagram, while having your own
  personalized author platform to showcase and sell your book.

# US Law Explained

`“The first duty of society is justice.”` — Alexander Hamilton

Clear, plain English guides to American law. Search for legal concepts, fundamental rights, and
practical tools below.


Search

## ⚖️ Understand the Law, Empower Yourself

### 🏛️ Core Legal Concepts

From [Negligence][50] to [Due Process][51], we break down the essential legal terms you need to
know. No jargon, just clear, plain English explanations designed to empower everyday readers.

### ⚙️ Understanding the System

Learn who's who and what's what in the American legal system. Understand the roles of [Judges][52]
and [Juries][53], the difference between [State And Federal Courts][54], and the process of a
[Lawsuit][55].

### 🛡️ Fundamental Rights

Grasp the principles that protect you. Explore your Constitutional guarantees, from [Freedom Of
Speech][56] to the right to a [Fair Trial][57] and protection against [Unreasonable Searches][58].

### 🧭 Practical Legal Guides

Step-by-step guides for real-life situations. Learn how to navigate common issues like [Starting A
Business][59], [Landlord-Tenant Disputes][60], or understanding a [Personal Injury Claim][61].

### 📜 Landmark Court Cases

Discover the stories that shaped the law today. We explain the impact of landmark Supreme Court
cases, from [Marbury V Madison][62] to [Brown V Board Of Education][63] and [Miranda V Arizona][64].

### 🏛️ Laws & Legislation

Get clear explanations of major federal laws that affect daily life, such as the [Civil Rights Act
Of 1964][65], the [Americans With Disabilities Act][66], and the [Family And Medical Leave Act][67].

## 🧮 Popular Legal Tools & Calculators

**[1031 Exchange Deadline][68]** Calculate deadlines for identifying and acquiring replacement
properties under Section 1031.

**[C-Corp vs. LLC Tree][69]** Interactive decision tree to help you evaluate and choose the right
business entity.

**[Injury Settlement Estimator][70]** Estimate the potential value of your personal injury claim and
settlement amount.

**[View All Legal Tools & Calculators >>][71]**

**Disclaimer:** The content on US Law Explained does not constitute legal advice. The legal
information is provided for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional legal
assistance. For specific legal issues, please consult with a qualified attorney.

# US Law Explained

`“The first duty of society is justice.”` — Alexander Hamilton

Clear, plain English guides to American law. Search for legal concepts, fundamental rights, and
practical tools below.


Search

## ⚖️ Understand the Law, Empower Yourself

### 🏛️ Core Legal Concepts

From [Negligence][50] to [Due Process][51], we break down the essential legal terms you need to
know. No jargon, just clear, plain English explanations designed to empower everyday readers.

### ⚙️ Understanding the System

Learn who's who and what's what in the American legal system. Understand the roles of [Judges][52]
and [Juries][53], the difference between [State And Federal Courts][54], and the process of a
[Lawsuit][55].

### 🛡️ Fundamental Rights

Grasp the principles that protect you. Explore your Constitutional guarantees, from [Freedom Of
Speech][56] to the right to a [Fair Trial][57] and protection against [Unreasonable Searches][58].

### 🧭 Practical Legal Guides

Step-by-step guides for real-life situations. Learn how to navigate common issues like [Starting A
Business][59], [Landlord-Tenant Disputes][60], or understanding a [Personal Injury Claim][61].

### 📜 Landmark Court Cases

Discover the stories that shaped the law today. We explain the impact of landmark Supreme Court
cases, from [Marbury V Madison][62] to [Brown V Board Of Education][63] and [Miranda V Arizona][64].

### 🏛️ Laws & Legislation

Get clear explanations of major federal laws that affect daily life, such as the [Civil Rights Act
Of 1964][65], the [Americans With Disabilities Act][66], and the [Family And Medical Leave Act][67].

## 🧮 Popular Legal Tools & Calculators

**[1031 Exchange Deadline][68]** Calculate deadlines for identifying and acquiring replacement
properties under Section 1031.

**[C-Corp vs. LLC Tree][69]** Interactive decision tree to help you evaluate and choose the right
business entity.

**[Injury Settlement Estimator][70]** Estimate the potential value of your personal injury claim and
settlement amount.

**[View All Legal Tools & Calculators >>][71]**

**Disclaimer:** The content on US Law Explained does not constitute legal advice. The legal
information is provided for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional legal
assistance. For specific legal issues, please consult with a qualified attorney.

districts and influencing real estate values. New restaurants, services, landscaped embankments, and
sports infrastructure are creating a self-sufficient urban environment that buyers receive together
with their homes. Anna Danchenok, Head of Real Estate and Urban Development at Yakov & Partners,
notes that major points of attraction increase the intensity of business and social connections,
generating additional economic activity. International benchmarks suggest that housing near such
assets can command a 5–15% premium, while commercial rents may be 10–35% higher than in comparable
locations.

July 2026
Large-scale AI adoption could generate a total effect of around RUB 900 billion for construction and
real estate. According to Anna Danchenok, Partner at Yakov & Partners, this could offset
approximately 5–6% of the decline in developer margins and bring the industry closer to its 2022
performance levels. Around 64% of developers already use AI, most actively in sales. The next stage
will involve expanding AI into other processes where automation can improve productivity and reduce
costs.

expertise

## In the media

[РБК]
July 2026
The fall in the Moscow Exchange Index has reinforced doubts about the prospects for new listings.
High key rates make deposits and bonds more attractive than equities, reduce company valuations, and
push potential issuers either to postpone IPOs or accept significant discounts. Andrey Stroganov,
Senior Analyst at the Yakov & Partners Analytics Center, notes that both macroeconomic and
geopolitical factors are weighing on the IPO market. Another risk is the changing investor base:
retail investors now account for roughly 70–80% of market activity, compared with about 41% in 2021,
increasing sensitivity to news and market volatility.
[Ведомости]
July 2026
The development of Luzhniki as a major sports and public cluster is increasing the appeal of nearby
districts and influencing real estate values. New restaurants, services, landscaped embankments, and
sports infrastructure are creating a self-sufficient urban environment that buyers receive together
with their homes. Anna Danchenok, Head of Real Estate and Urban Development at Yakov & Partners,
notes that major points of attraction increase the intensity of business and social connections,
generating additional economic activity. International benchmarks suggest that housing near such
assets can command a 5–15% premium, while commercial rents may be 10–35% higher than in comparable
locations.
[TASS]
July 2026
Large-scale AI adoption could generate a total effect of around RUB 900 billion for construction and
real estate. According to Anna Danchenok, Partner at Yakov & Partners, this could offset
approximately 5–6% of the decline in developer margins and bring the industry closer to its 2022
performance levels. Around 64% of developers already use AI, most actively in sales. The next stage
will involve expanding AI into other processes where automation can improve productivity and reduce
costs.
[Show more][18]
